import unittest
from unittest import mock

import factory


class MaybeDeciderRegressionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_faker_decider_defaults(self):
        for locale in (None, 'fr_FR'):
            for choice in (False, True):
                with self.subTest(locale=locale, choice=choice):
                    decider = factory.Faker(

                    class TestFactory(factory.DictFactory):
                        value = factory.Maybe(decider, 'yes', 'no')

                    with mock.patch.object(decider, '_get_faker') as get_faker:
                        get_faker.return_value.format.return_value = choice
                        for _ in range(2):
                            self.assertEqual(

                        self.assertEqual(get_faker.call_args, mock.call(locale))
                        self.assertEqual(

                            mock.call('boolean', chance_of_getting_true=42))

        class TestFactory(factory.DictFactory):
            value = factory.Maybe(
                factory.Faker(

                'yes', 'no')

        self.assertEqual(TestFactory()['value'], 'yes')
